rules.title: 🏄 Prime Surfing Window Active!
rules.message: Clean offshore wind (12 km/h) and moderate temperature. Ideal wave conditions right now!

rules.title: 🌊 High Surf & Choppy Waters Advisory
rules.message: Strong onshore winds exceeding 28 km/h. Choppy water and hazardous rip currents possible.

rules.title: 🚴 Perfect Cycling Window Open!
rules.message: Dry asphalt, gentle breeze, and mild temperature. Great time for a road or trail ride!

rules.title: 🌧️ Wet Tarmac Warning for Cyclists
rules.message: Recent precipitation may cause slippery corners. Reduce speed and check brake distance.

rules.title: 🏃 Crisp Air Running Window!
rules.message: Ideal atmospheric cooling and low humidity. Perfect for an outdoor tempo run or 5K.

rules.title: 🔥 High Temperature Running Alert
rules.message: Temperature above 32°C. Hydrate heavily and prefer shaded paths or evening jogs.

rules.title: 🥾 Panoramic Trail Weather!
rules.message: Clear visibility and mild mountain breezes. Ideal conditions for summit hikes and nature walks.

rules.title: ⚡ Mountain Ridge Storm Alert
rules.message: Rapid weather shift detected. Avoid exposed peaks and seek covered trail shelters.

rules.title: ⛵ Steady Sailing Breeze Detected!
rules.message: Consistent 16 km/h wind velocity with calm seas. Superb window for coastal cruising.

rules.title: 🏊 Warm Sun & Gentle Waters!
rules.message: Warm ambient temperature and calm breeze. Great time for open water swimming.

rules.title: 📸 Scenic Golden Hour Lighting!
rules.message: Soft atmospheric diffusion and dynamic cloud patterns. Get your camera ready for landscape shots.

rules.title: 🧘 Serene Outdoor Yoga Window
rules.message: Calm air, peaceful temperature, and gentle sunlight. Perfect for garden or park mindfulness.

environmentalAlerts.title: ☀️ Extreme UV Radiation Index
environmentalAlerts.message: UV index reaching critical levels. Apply SPF 50+, wear polarized sunglasses, and limit midday exposure.

environmentalAlerts.title: ⛈️ Severe Rain & Thunderstorm Expected
environmentalAlerts.message: High-intensity storm cell approaching. Secure loose outdoor gear and prepare for localized waterlogging.

environmentalAlerts.title: 💨 High Wind Velocity Warning
environmentalAlerts.message: Gale gusts over 32 km/h detected. Outdoor canopy setups and high-profile cycling not advised.
